continuityDecision.structuralMeaning: The scar-lock readiness marker means the Grave can later resolve into a controlled scar-memory seam, not a door, menu, teleport, or instant return.
continuityDecision.worldFacingMeaning: The Grave is not finished after the safe silt transfer. The next authored pressure should ask the player to understand why the scar protected the remains before any route can continue.
continuityDecision.whyNotReturnImmediately: Returning to Bloom would resolve pressure too quickly and would make Grave feel like a side pickup instead of the first real route of memory and unfinished becoming.
continuityDecision.whyNotRouteHandoffYet: A wider route handoff would require new branch architecture before the Grave pocket has earned its own continuity grammar.

candidateContinuityOptions.label: Return to Bloom Residue

candidateContinuityOptions.label: Deeper Grave / Scar-Memory Seam
candidateContinuityOptions.reason: Best continuation because it keeps the first Grave route focused on memory, scar protection, inheritance restraint, and read-before-consume meaning.

candidateContinuityOptions.label: Route Handoff / Wider Memory Route
candidateContinuityOptions.reason: Too wide for HC-004I. Requires a locked next-cell recipe and another acceptance pass before runtime activation.
